inlines.v: FLEX'IBLENESS, noun 1. Possibility to be bent or turned from a straight line or form without breaking; easiness to be bent; pliantness; pliancy; flexibility. 2. Facility of mind; readiness to comply or yield; obsequiousness; as the flexibleness of a courtier.
